# First Peoples Cultural Council

> FPCC funds and supports First Nations language revitalization, arts development, and cultural heritage preservation across British Columbia.

The First Peoples Cultural Council (FPCC) is the primary funding and support organization for First Nations language, arts, culture and heritage initiatives in B.C. The site provides access to multiple grant programs, training opportunities, and resources designed to strengthen Indigenous cultural sovereignty and community-led revitalization efforts.

## Key Topics

- First Nations language revitalization
- Language immersion programs
- First Nations arts funding
- Cultural heritage preservation
- B.C. First Nations
- Grant programs

## Language Programs

- [Language Program](https://fpcc.ca/language): Language Program: funding, training and resources for First Nations language revitalization.
- [Language Vitality Program](https://fpcc.ca/program/language-vitality-program): Language Vitality Program: funding for community-led First Nations language revitalization.
- [Mentor-Apprentice Program](https://fpcc.ca/program/mentor-apprentice-program): Mentor-Apprentice Program: 300 hours of one-on-one language immersion funding for learners.
- [Youth Empowered Speakers Program](https://fpcc.ca/program/yes): YES Program: paid language immersion for B.C. First Nations youth ages 18-35.
- [About Our Language Programs](https://fpcc.ca/programs/about-our-language-programs): Documentation of FPCC language programs including mentor-apprentice and immersion initiatives.

## Arts Programs

- [Arts Program](https://fpcc.ca/arts): Arts Program: grants and training for B.C. First Nations artists in ancestral and contemporary arts.
- [Individual Artists Program](https://fpcc.ca/program/individual-artists-program): Individual Artists Program: grants for artistic development of B.C. First Nations creators.
- [Arts Strengthening Program](https://fpcc.ca/program/arts-strengthening): Arts Strengthening Program: mentorships and knowledge transfer for First Nations artists.
- [Arts Infrastructure Program](https://fpcc.ca/program/arts-infrastructure-program): Arts Infrastructure Program: funding for First Nations-led nonprofit arts spaces and administration.
- [Arts Vitality Grant](https://fpcc.ca/program/arts-vitality-grant): Arts Vitality Grant: up to $10,000 for creative projects supporting B.C. First Nations arts.
- [Music Program](https://fpcc.ca/program/music-program): Music Program: grants and training for B.C. First Nations music professionals and creatives.
- [About Our Arts Program](https://fpcc.ca/programs/about-our-arts-program): Documentation of FPCC arts programs supporting First Nations artists and creative sovereignty.

## Heritage & Cultural Programs

- [Braided Knowledge Grant](https://fpcc.ca/program/braided-knowledge): Braided Knowledge Grant: funding for projects connecting arts, language and cultural heritage.
- [Braided Infrastructure Program](https://fpcc.ca/program/braided-infrastructure-program): Braided Infrastructure Program: funding for First Nations cultural infrastructure projects.
- [Cultural Practices Grant](https://fpcc.ca/program/cultural-practices-grant): Cultural Practices Grant: funding for B.C. First Nations community cultural events and documentation.
- [About Our Heritage Programs](https://fpcc.ca/programs/about-our-heritage-programs): Heritage Programs overview: funding for First Nations heritage stewardship and cultural practices.

## Funding & Grants

- [FPCC Grant Funding](https://fpcc.ca/grants): FPCC grant funding overview for language, arts and heritage revitalization projects.
